api_surface: google.genai Client.interactions.create (Gemini Interactions API; direct Gemini, not Vertex)
api_status: GA: the Gemini Interactions API is Generally Available (since June 2026) and recommended by Google for new projects. In google-genai 2.11.0 it is exposed through google.genai.interactions; the public module re-exports generated types and resources implemented under internal _gaos modules (an SDK implementation detail, not the API's lifecycle). The 'Agents usage is experimental' warning is agent-specific (fires only from client.agents) and does NOT apply to model Interaction requests. Implementation risk: client.interactions.create and its generated request types must be revalidated when google-genai is upgraded. Offline evidence uses schema-validated native dictionaries with the SDK's real field names.

claimed_feature_support.note: SDK operations implemented in this probe against Gemini Interactions-native shapes. A framework/SDK operation succeeding OFFLINE says nothing about live Gemini behavior or model support; both remain UNVERIFIED until a live run (DevSpec Section 55).
claimed_feature_support.roles: sdk_operation_implemented (top-level system_instruction + user_input step, not a user message)
claimed_feature_support.structured_output: sdk_operation_implemented (native response_format text/application-json/jsonSchema; raw schema preserved; NOT a synthetic tool)
claimed_feature_support.tools: sdk_operation_implemented (native function tool; function_call step id/name/arguments captured; requires_action status)
claimed_feature_support.usage: sdk_operation_implemented (total_input/output/thought/cached token totals captured; absent stays absent)
claimed_feature_support.errors: sdk_operation_implemented (SDK exception type + cause chain + code/status captured)

native_semantics_notes: The system instruction is a TOP-LEVEL system_instruction, not a user-input message.
The authoritative response is the full Interaction resource (id/status/steps/usage); output_text is a separate SDK convenience projection.
store=false is set on EVERY request; previous_interaction_id is never used; each base fixture is stateless single-turn.
Thought steps / thought-signature deltas are preserved ONLY as opaque structural/protocol evidence; no hidden reasoning text is requested, normalized, or reported.
A function_call step yields status requires_action; P0.6B captures the first function-call step only and never submits a function result (no second provider turn).
known_limitations: No live evidence exists yet; all P0.6B verification is offline via a narrow injected fake returning native Interaction/event dictionaries without the network.

The Interactions API is GA; the generated Python types/resources (re-exported from internal _gaos) may evolve on SDK upgrade, so native dicts are used offline and client.interactions.create must be revalidated when google-genai is upgraded.
Multimodal, parallel tools, cancellation, timeout, retry, embeddings are out of P0.6B scope.
No Vertex mode, no ADC, no OpenRouter, no OpenAI-compat endpoint, no custom base_url; only a direct GEMINI_API_KEY satisfies the live credential gate.
